lines.en: label halloweenfive6:
scene partybeforethe1
Back in a room where things make more sense, things weren’t making much sense.
lines.zh: 回到一个本该一切都说得通的房间里，事情却不太说得通了。

lines.en: I suppose you could say that about most of these little get-togethers, though.
lines.zh: 不过，我想你大概对大多数这种小聚会都能这么说。

lines.en: Or at least parts of them. For the highlights of a tragic life would not be highlights at all if you knew they were coming.
lines.zh: 至少对其中一部分能这么说。因为如果你提前知道悲剧人生的高光时刻要来了，那它们就不算高光了。

lines.en: It’s the suspense that makes it all worth it. It’s not knowing that motivates you to find out. It’s the ups and downs and turnarounds that turns paths to roads and roads to towns.
lines.zh: 正是那份悬念让一切值得。正是「不知道」驱使你去找答案。正是那些起起伏伏、峰回路转，把小径变成大路、把大路变成城镇。

lines.en: Far from here, there’s another party. One we weren’t invited to. Probably in some rich girl’s mansion and probably full of scantily clad teens fawning over someone they shouldn’t.
lines.zh: 在远离这里的地方，还有另一场派对。一场我们没被邀请的派对。大概在某个富家女的豪宅里，大概挤满了衣不蔽体的少女，围着某个她们不该围着的人犯花痴。

lines.en: And far away from that one is another. Then another. Then another.
lines.zh: 而在那场之外，还有另一场。然后再一场。然后再一场。

lines.en: And the only thing that makes where we are {i}now{/i} more important than those is the fact that we can {i}guess{/i} what will happen next.
lines.zh: 而我们{i}现在{/i}所在的地方之所以比那些更重要，唯一的原因是——我们{i}猜{/i}得到接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: It’s not the fact that this world is {i}weird.{/i} It’s not the fact that sometimes it might feel a little supernatural when that could just be the norm in this setting.
lines.zh: 不是因为这个世界很{i}怪{/i}。也不是因为有时候它给人的感觉有点超自然——尽管在这个设定里那也许只是常态。

lines.en: It’s just where and when we happen to be. But what will happen to the faces and names we’ve come to know when we finally {i}are{/i} invited somewhere else? Somewhere better?
lines.zh: 只{i}是{/i}因为我们恰好身处的时空。可当我们终于被邀请去别的地方、更好的地方时，那些我们已经熟悉的面孔和名字会怎样？

lines.en: Or somewhere that might {i}seem{/i} better, but...what if there’s another wall that’s even harder to scale and we just haven’t seen it yet?
lines.zh: 或者某个{i}看起来{/i}更好的地方……可万一那里还有另一堵更难翻越的墙，而我们只是还没看见呢？

lines.en: What if {i}that’s{/i} why things always come to an end on that rooftop? What if God just doesn’t want us to catch wind of a new life because we might let it carry us off to his front lawn?
lines.zh: 万一{i}这{/i}就是为什么事情总是在那个天台上收尾？万一 God 只是不想让我们嗅到新生活的气息，因为我们可能会让那气息把我们带到他家的前草坪上？

lines.en: Anyway, I guess what I’m trying to say here is that I {i}want{/i} to say you should learn to look past the confusion and try to find complacency in this moment.
lines.zh: 总之，我想我在这里想说的是，我{i}想{/i}说你应该学会看透这些困惑，试着在此刻找到安于现状的满足。

lines.en: But I only {i}want{/i} to say that in the first place because that’s what the outline says I’m {i}supposed{/i} to say.
lines.zh: 但我{i}想{/i}这么说，首先只是因为大纲上写着我{i}该{/i}这么说。

lines.en: In all actuality, I don’t really want you to do anything.
lines.zh: 而实际上，我根本不想让你做任何事。

lines.en: I don’t want you to stand out or feel or think or even remember that there’s some sentience buried somewhere deep inside of you, because then you might leave.
lines.zh: 我不想让你显眼、不想让你感受、不想让你思考，甚至不想让你记起在你内心深处埋着某种意识——因为那样你也许会离开。

lines.en: You might realize this party sucks and head off to another one. In another rich girl’s mansion. With some other misguided teens. And you might enjoy it more, sure.
lines.zh: 你也许会意识到这场派对很烂，然后动身去另一场。在另一个富家女的豪宅里。和另一些迷途的少女一起。你也许会玩得更开心，当然。

lines.en: But you also might wind up like these two — misplaced, awkward, and unsure of who to speak to or where to look when that used to be so easy.
lines.zh: 但你也可能落得和这两个人一样的下场——格格不入、局促不安，不知道该跟谁说话、该往哪儿看，尽管这些曾经轻而易举。

lines.en: When the walls close in on this garden of ours, we all become wallflowers.
lines.zh: 当我们这座花园四周的墙壁合拢时，我们都成了壁花。

lines.en: But there is no inherent harm in that if it’s what makes you breathe easier.
lines.zh: 但如果那能让你呼吸顺畅一点，本身也没什么害处。

lines.en: Some people just {i}want{/i} to suffocate, I think.
lines.zh: 我觉得，有些人就是{i}想{/i}窒息而已。

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 而且……

lines.en: I think I’m one of them.
lines.zh: 我想我就是其中之一。
: 那么……

lines.en: Even here, I can’t find peace.
lines.zh: 即便在这里，我也找不到安宁。

lines.en: : Sooo...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: This was all for nothing.
lines.zh: 这一切都白费了。

lines.en: : How’s, like...maid life going and stuff?
lines.zh: : 那个……女仆生活过得怎么样之类的？

lines.en: Those ups and downs and turnarounds I praised just moments ago have entangled to the point where I can no longer find my footing in a world that {i}I{/i} built.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}刚刚才夸过的那些起起伏伏、峰回路转，现在已经缠成一团，让我在自己建造的世界里再也找不到落脚点。

lines.en: : It’s fine. How’s...promiscuous life?
lines.zh: : 挺好的。你的……滥交生活怎么样？

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: : Fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 还好吧，大概。

lines.en: As I look down at my hands and their multicolored glow, I realize something. Or I make something up. Or I trick myself into thinking that-
lines.zh: 我低头看着自己双手那五彩斑斓的光，意识到了什么。或者我编造了什么。或者我骗自己去相信——

lines.en: I didn’t build this world at all.
lines.zh: 这个世界根本不是我建的。

lines.en: It has always been here.
lines.zh: 它一直都在这里。

lines.en: : I take exception to my life being called “promiscuous,” though. I’m really not like that.
lines.zh: : 不过，我抗议把自己的生活叫做「滥交」。我真的不是那种人。

lines.en: And it will remain so long as the rules are followed.
lines.zh: 而只要规则被遵守，它就会一直在这里。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe2
: Yeah, I know. I just...wasn’t really sure how else to respond since you caught me off guard.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。我只是……不太确定还能怎么接，因为你让我措手不及。

lines.en: Please-
lines.zh: 拜托——

lines.en: Don’t leave me alone again.
lines.zh: 别再把我一个人丢下了。

lines.en: : You doing okay? It’s weird seeing you not, like...running around and talking to everybody at these things.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？在这些场合看到你不……到处跑、跟所有人聊天，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : The...same could be said for you, couldn’t it? Why aren’t you hanging out with Noriko? Or Miku or...your other friends?
lines.zh: : 那个……你不一样吗？你为什么不跟 Noriko 待在一起？或者 Miku，或者……你的其他朋友？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe3
: Thanks for pretending I have other friends. I now forgive you for calling me “promiscuous.”
lines.zh: : 谢谢你假装我还有其他朋友。我现在原谅你叫我「滥交」了。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}always{/i} have to be with them, though. In fact, I’m normally pretty alone. I’m used to it. Just...not normally in a party setting.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不必{i}总是{/i}跟她们在一起。事实上，我平时基本都是一个人。我习惯了。只是……在派对上通常不是这样。

lines.en: : But hey, a lot’s been changing lately. So maybe I’ll wind up just as jaded and antisocial as Io after a few more of these things.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，最近变化挺多的。所以也许再经历几次这种场合，我就会变得和 Io 一样愤世嫉俗、不爱社交了。

lines.en: : I wasn’t {i}pretending{/i} you have other friends, Kirin. You do. You just might not be as close to them as you are with the others.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}假装{/i}你有其他朋友，Kirin。你确实有。只是你和她们的关系也许没有和另一些人那么亲近。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe4
: That’s not really a problem, though. Like...Io is my only {i}close{/i} friend. So in that department, you’re kind of beating me.
lines.zh: : 那其实不是什么问题。比如……Io 是我唯一{i}亲近{/i}的朋友。所以在这方面，你还赢过我呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe. But do you ever really feel {i}alone,{/i} Uta?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可你真的有觉得自己{i}孤独{/i}过吗，Uta？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe5
: Huh?
: Is that smile you keep plastered to your face all day every day a reflection of how you actually feel? Or do you just keep it there because it makes pretending to be happy easier?
lines.zh: : 你每天从早到晚贴在脸上那个笑容，是你真实感受的反映吗？还是你只是把它挂在那儿，因为那样假装开心比较容易？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe6
: It’s no problem if you do. That’s not me, like...trying to call you out or anything. It’s just that I kind of do the same thing.
lines.zh: : 如果是后者也没关系。我不是……要揭穿你什么的。只是我其实也在做同样的事。

lines.en: : Pretending to be something you’re not can be exhausting, though. Which is why girls like us need to decompress by awkwardly retreating to the sidelines at parties sometimes.
lines.zh: : 不过，假装成另一个人是很累的。所以像我们这样的女生，有时候需要靠在派对上尴尬地退到边上来解压。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s any shame in that, though. So, from one poser to another — good luck.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得那没什么可耻的。所以，从一个装模作样的人到另一个——祝你好运。

lines.en: : We clearly need it.
lines.zh: : 我们显然需要好运。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe7
: You look really pretty today, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你今天真好看，Kirin。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe8
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : You too, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你也是，Uta。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe9
: Secret meeting — start! Let the planning of our next slumber party commence!
lines.zh: : 秘密会议——开始！让我们来筹划下一次睡衣派对吧！

lines.en: : Is it really a secret if you shout it at the top of your lungs in a room full of our classmates?
lines.zh: : 你在一屋子同班同学面前扯着嗓子喊，这还叫秘密吗？

lines.en: : I kind of have to since Noriko invited Good Kid again. The sound system in here is too powerful and this song is filling me with a deep melancholy.
lines.zh: : 我不得不这样啊，因为 Noriko 又把 Good Kid 请来了。这里的音响太猛了，这首歌让我陷入了深深的忧郁。

lines.en: : Yeah, I have no idea how Kirin and Uta are having a conversation like, right in front of them. They’re going to go deaf.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我真不懂 Kirin 和 Uta 怎么能就在他们正前方那样聊天。她们要聋了。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe10
: WHAT?! I CAN’T HEAR YOU GUYS!
lines.zh: : 什么？！我听不见你们！

lines.en: : Oh no. The melancholy has already consumed Noriko.
lines.zh: : 哦不。忧郁已经吞噬了 Noriko。

lines.en: : WHAT KIND OF DOG WAS IT?!
lines.zh: : 那是什么品种的狗？！

lines.en: scene partybeforethe11
: Two questions.
lines.zh: : 两个问题。

lines.en: : Two answers.
lines.zh: : 两个答案。

lines.en: : The fuck happened to your gloves? They’ve got more holes in ‘em than my socks.
lines.zh: : 你那手套怎么回事？上面的洞比我的袜子还多。

lines.en: : Various types of acids. Don’t worry about it. What’s your second question?
lines.zh: : 各种酸。别在意。你第二个问题是什么？

lines.en: : I only have more now.
lines.zh: : 我现在问题更多了。

lines.en: : Okay, but what was the {i}original{/i} second question? We don’t have all day, Yumi! It’s only a matter of time until our secret meeting is discovered!
lines.zh: : 好吧，可你{i}原本{/i}的第二个问题是什么？我们没那么多时间，Yumi！我们的秘密会议随时会被发现！

lines.en: : THEY FOUND {i}WHAT{/i} IN FIJI?!
lines.zh: : 他们在斐济发现了{i}什么{/i}？！

lines.en: : We’re really doin’ this shit again? After the last time accomplished literally nothing?
lines.zh: : 我们真的又要搞这套？上次可是字面意义上什么都没成啊？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe12
: It didn’t accomplish {i}nothing!{/i} We managed to enlist you, didn’t we?! It just...didn’t accomplish what we {i}thought{/i} it would accomplish! But that’s what the second one is for!
lines.zh: : 才不是{i}什么都没成{/i}！我们不是成功把你拉进来了吗？！只是……没有达成我们原本{i}以为{/i}会达成的目标！但那正是第二次的意义所在！

lines.en: : You sure you don’t just...really fuckin’ like slumber parties?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是就……他妈的真的很喜欢睡衣派对？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe13
: Me? Pfft. Of course not! I’m doing this to save the world and bring back my friend. As if I’d use that as an excuse to stay up late and eat snacks with my {i}other{/i} friends.
lines.zh: : 我？噗。当然不是！我做这些是为了拯救世界、把我的朋友带回来。就好像我会拿这个当借口熬到很晚、和我{i}其他{/i}朋友一起吃零食似的。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe14
: But yeah! We’re doing it again. Just this time, I’m going to try and get even more girls involved. So {i}everyone{/i} is getting an invite and we’re going balls to the wall!
lines.zh: : 不过对！我们要再来一次。只是这次，我要试着拉更多女生进来。所以{i}每个人{/i}都会收到邀请，我们要全力以赴！

lines.en: : Aight. But only one of us has balls and I’m bailing the second anyone starts talkin’ about them.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过我们之中只有一个有蛋，而且谁一开始聊蛋我就立刻撤。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe15
: Hi. Testicle-bearer here. Why didn’t we just do it like this to begin with?
lines.zh: : 嗨。带蛋的那个在这儿。我们为什么不一开始就这么干？

lines.en: : Because Ayane is just making all of this up as she goes. And probably cares more about the slumber parties than the actual apocalypse like Yumi suggested.
lines.zh: : 因为 Ayane 完全是边做边编。而且就像 Yumi 说的，她大概更在乎睡衣派对，而不是真正的末日。

lines.en: : I care about both! There’s no rule against that!
lines.zh: : 两个我都关心！这又不犯法！

lines.en: scene partybeforethe16
: Than why not seize this opportunity to make an announcement in front of everyone?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不趁这个机会当着所有人的面宣布？

lines.en: : While those Canadians are up there playin’ music and shit? Ain’t that kinda rude?
lines.zh: : 趁那几个加拿大人在上面演奏什么的？那不太礼貌吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I can’t just interrupt Good Kid, Makoto. They’re stuck here until they’re allowed to leave the country again, so the least we can do is show them what omotenashi is all about.
lines.zh: : 是的。我不能就这么打断 Good Kid，Makoto。他们被困在这儿，直到被允许再次出境为止，所以我们至少该让他们见识一下什么叫 omotenashi。

lines.en: : Should I...go get Molly for another weebnote?...
lines.zh: : 我要不要……去叫 Molly 再来一张死宅便签？……

lines.en: : Not right now! Besides, Maya and Ami still aren’t here.
lines.zh: : 现在不用！再说，Maya 和 Ami 还没到呢。

lines.en: : Isn’t that a {i}good{/i} thing? I thought we were trying to keep this away from them?
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}好{/i}事吗？我以为我们正想瞒着她们？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe17
: Ami, yes. Maya is more of a mixed bag. But just inviting them to the mega slumber party isn’t giving anything away. Like, wouldn’t it be more suspicious if they {i}weren’t{/i} invited?
lines.zh: : Ami 是的。Maya 就不好说了。不过光是邀请她们来这场超大型睡衣派对，并不会泄露什么。比如，如果她们{i}没被邀请{/i}，不是更可疑吗？

lines.en: : Probably not for Ami. Pretty much everyone hates her now, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 对 Ami 大概不会。现在基本所有人都讨厌她了吧？

lines.en: : Everybody hates me too. This shit sounds fuckin’ horrible, I ain’t gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 所有人也都讨厌我。这破事听着真他妈糟心，我不骗你。

lines.en: : You guys just don’t get it!
lines.zh: : 你们就是不懂！

lines.en: scene partybeforethe18
: Are you hearing any of this, Sana? Because my ears aren’t great to begin with and it doesn’t help that I think I just heard Yumi say she wants to fuck Ami.
lines.zh: : Sana，你有听到这些吗？因为我耳朵本来就不好，而且我好像刚听到 Yumi 说她想操 Ami，这让情况更糟了。

lines.en: : Sana? You’re not deaf too, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : Sana？你不会也聋了吧？

lines.en: : You’ve been...holding onto his arm for...a while now...
lines.zh: : 你已经……抓着他的胳膊……好一会儿了……

lines.en: scene partybeforethe19
: Do you...want a turn?
lines.zh: : 你……想来一轮吗？

lines.en: : Can I...actually have one?
lines.zh: : 我真的……可以吗？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe20
: Of course! Just give me another few minutes to finish recharging my battery and we can swap places. But you can hold mine in the meantime if you want!
lines.zh: : 当然！再给我几分钟充完电，我们就可以换位置了。不过你要是想的话，可以先抓着我的！

lines.en: : Do I need to start charging rent for my arm?
lines.zh: : 我是不是该开始为我的胳膊收租金了？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe21
: YOU’RE BUYING A FARM?!
lines.zh: : 你要买一座农场？！

lines.en: : How can you hear me and not him?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么听得见我说话却听不见他的？……

lines.en: scene partybeforethe22
: So! Where are we going to do it this time?! Sensei’s house? There’s still the matter of that one Dorm Wars prize no one ever redeemed, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 那么！这次我们要在哪儿办？！Sensei 家？不是还有那个一直没人兑换的宿舍战争奖品吗？

lines.en: : Sure, if you all want to sleep in the street outside. No one really drives down it, so you’ll probably be safe.
lines.zh: : 行啊，如果你们都想睡在外面的街上的话。那条街基本没车过，所以你们大概会很安全。

lines.en: : Are you certain you don’t want to hold another meeting with Yumi this time now that she’s able to...you know...be involved with this to a certain extent?
lines.zh: : 你确定这次不想再和 Yumi 开一次会——既然她现在能……你知道的……在一定程度上参与进来了？

lines.en: : Being able to and {i}wanting{/i} to are two totally different things. This shit goes way over my head. Just let me fuckin’ pretend it ain’t real or whatever.
lines.zh: : 「能」和「{i}想{/i}」是两码事。这破事远远超出我的理解范围。就让我他妈假装它不存在之类的吧。

lines.en: : What...are you guys even talking about? I’m not really sure I’m...following.
lines.zh: : 你们……到底在说什么？我不太确定我……跟上。

lines.en: : That’s because the world doesn’t {i}want{/i} you to follow, Sana! Which is why you will now repeat after yourself when I tell you we’re caught in-
lines.zh: : 那是因为这个世界不{i}想{/i}让你跟上，Sana！所以现在我要你照我说的重复自己的话——我说我们被困在——

lines.en: : What...are you guys even talking about? I’m not really sure I’m...following.
lines.zh: : 你们……到底在说什么？我不太确定我……跟上。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe23
: Sana? Why are you repeating yourself? Didn’t you just say that?
lines.zh: : Sana？你为什么重复自己的话？你刚才不是已经说过了吗？

lines.en: : Wait a second! Does this mean Noriko-
lines.zh: : 等等！那是不是意味着 Noriko——

lines.en: : She isn’t {i}aware.{/i} She just can’t hear us.
lines.zh: : 她并不{i}知情{/i}。她只是听不见我们。

lines.en: : God, that repetition shit never stops being weird as hell. Can’t believe I live in a fuckin’ anime now.
lines.zh: : 天哪，这种重复的东西永远都那么诡异。不敢相信我现在活在一部该死的动漫里。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe24
: OKAY! BUT THEN YOU’LL HAVE TO WASH MINE AS WELL!
lines.zh: : 好的！但那样你也得把我的洗了！

lines.en: : What...did she even think she heard that time?
lines.zh: : 她那次到底以为自己听到了什么？

lines.en: : Probably best if we never find out...
lines.zh: : 大概我们永远别知道比较好……

lines.en: So there they were! Just an hour or two into the party and already planning out what comes next.
lines.zh: 她们就在那儿！派对才开始一两个小时，就已经在筹划接下来要做什么了。

lines.en: Of course, not all of them were on the same wavelength. Especially when there are {b}INFINITE{/b} wavelengths carrying {b}INFINITE{/b} messages to {b}INFINITE{/b} people.
lines.zh: 当然，并不是所有人都踩在同一个波长上。尤其是当有{b}无限{/b}的波长、向{b}无限{/b}的人传递着{b}无限{/b}的信息时。

lines.en: But that’s PART OF THE CHARM. It’s the REASON WE’RE HERE. We exist to DELIVER THOSE MESSAGES ourselves because radios are weak now! Its consciousness that moves!
lines.zh: 但那正是魅力所在。那正是我们在此的原因。我们存在的意义就是亲自去传递那些信息，因为无线电已经衰弱了！能移动的是意识！

lines.en: The earth doesn’t spin! The earth is flat! You’ve already seen where the sidewalk ends! You’ve already fallen through the map! You know this to be true!
lines.zh: 地球不转！地球是平的！你已经见过人行道尽头了！你已经从地图上掉下去了！你知道这是真的！

lines.en: Stop thinking you are where you aren’t! Stretch out your arms and embrace the way it feels to don the fresh skin of tainted youth, for it makes {i}tainting{/i} youth all the more palatable!
lines.zh: 别再以为你在你并不在的地方！张开双臂，去拥抱披上那被玷污的青春的新鲜皮肤的感觉，因为那会让{i}玷污{/i}青春这件事变得更加可口！

lines.en: scene partybeforethe25
What if there was no one at the party?
lines.zh: 万一派对上一个人都没有呢？

lines.en: What if everyone {i}did{/i} leave? And I was here, talking to myself, manipulating the reflections in the floor so you would never see {i}mine?{/i}
lines.zh: 万一所有人都走了呢？而我在这儿自言自语，操纵着地板上的倒影，好让你永远看不到{i}我的{/i}倒影？

lines.en: What {b}IF{/b} I say to live is {b}SIN?!{/b} To panic as the walls close in?! Where {b}DOES{/b} that ancient guardian relieve itself if not {b}WITHIN?{/b}
lines.zh: {b}万一{/b}我说「活着即是{b}罪{/b}」呢？！在墙壁合拢时恐慌？！那位古老的守护者若不在{b}「内」{/b}，又能在何处排泄？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe26
The sculptures leave too.
lines.zh: 雕塑也离去了。

lines.en: scene partybeforethe27
As do the chains.
lines.zh: 锁链亦然。

lines.en: scene black
And then there is nothing.
lines.zh: 然后什么都不剩。

lines.en: But there will not be “nothing” for long.
lines.zh: 但「无」不会持续太久。

lines.en: Soon, a creator will come and do what a creator does.
lines.zh: 很快，一位造物主会到来，做造物主该做的事。

lines.en: Give you a reason to stop.
lines.zh: 给你一个停下的理由。

lines.en: To stay.
lines.zh: 让你留下。

lines.en: To think, sometimes, when the mood is right.
lines.zh: 让你在气氛对的时候，偶尔思考。

lines.en: Or to fail.
lines.zh: 或者失败。

lines.en: It’s only human to make mistakes.
lines.zh: 犯错是人之常情。

lines.en: But what if humans {i}are{/i} mistakes?
lines.zh: 可万一人类本身{i}就是{/i}错误呢？

lines.en: scene partybeforethe9
: Secret meeting — start! Let the planning of-
lines.zh: : 秘密会议——开始！让我们来筹划——

lines.en: scene partybeforethe28
: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
